entities.name: Commander Grizzlegom
entities.description: Hurloon minotaur who led part of the Coalition forces during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Weatherlight crew member who rescued Grizzlegom's people.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: Metathran commander who had Grizzlegom kill him to prevent zombification.

entities.name: Dralnu
entities.description: Commander who infected Agnate with a plague; executed by the metathran.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Elvish Coalition leader who joined Grizzlegom's attack.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Fought alongside Grizzlegom and transported minotaurs to Hurloon.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler who came to Dominaria through the portal.

entities.name: Liin Sivi
entities.description: Took part in the raid on the Stronghold.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Trapped in the throne-room with Squee and Urza.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Phyrexian fortress in a volcano in Urborg.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event after which Grizzlegom's people were subdued.

events.summary: Tahngarth and the Weatherlight crew rescue the subdued minotaur army and take it to Urborg.
events.quote: were rescued by Tahngarth and the Weatherlight crew

events.summary: Agnate signs his command over and has Grizzlegom kill him to avoid becoming Dralnu's minion; Dralnu is executed by the metathran.
events.quote: had Grizzlegom kill him to stop him from becoming Dralnu's minion

events.summary: Grizzlegom is devoured by a Gargantua but tears out, his hide and horns twisted.
events.quote: Grizzlegom was devoured by a Phyrexian Gargantua

events.summary: Eladamri allies with the stone dwarves and raids the Stronghold with Grizzlegom; Yawgmoth arrives and all flee.
events.quote: Yawgmoth came to Dominaria through the portal to Phyrexia in the throne room

events.summary: The Legacy is triggered, saving Grizzlegom from Yawgmoth's death cloud.
events.quote: saved from certain death by the triggering of the Legacy

relations.quote: Grizzlegom was soon joined in his attack by another Coalition leader: Eladamri
confronted Dralnu, who tried to accuse Grizzlegom of Agnate's murder
